output.summary: A flowering plant native to Bangladesh, Thailand, Laos, Vietnam and southeastern and south-central China, where it inhabits tropical swamps and rainforests. It has lance-shaped leaves growing from a central point and occasionally produces white flowers followed by oval reddish fruits. Its calcium oxalate crystals are poisonous if ingested and can severely burn and swell the mouth and tongue.
output.edibilityNote: Calcium oxalate crystals make the plant poisonous if ingested, causing severe burning and swelling of the mouth and tongue.
